Synopsis:
Dialog with Mattis in Haven. He's a young tiefling boy who dreams of opening up his own shop in baldur's gate. He's delighted to be given the responsibility of the 'shop' in the Last Light Inn and does his best to sound more 'grown-up' and 'formal'. But he fumbles it a bit.This is his main dialogue in Haven and covers all major states, Isobel and Mol kidnapped, the Inn attacked, tieflings dead, etc.

Cluster Contexts:
- HAV_TieflingSurvivors_Mattis.json: Mattis is a young tiefling in Haven who’s been thrilled to be put in charge of the Last Light Inn’s little “shop” and is trying — a bit awkwardly — to sound grown‑up and businesslike. In the lines shown Mol (an older tiefling at the inn) has put him in charge and even entrusted him with a mysterious key Mattis is reluctant to part with. Off‑screen, the town has recently been attacked and tieflings have been killed; depending on playthroughs Isobel and/or Mol may be missing or kidnapped, so the inn is a tense, fragile refuge. Other survivor threads (for example Dammon, Ide and Rolan) and personal conflicts from those earlier events help explain Mattis’s prideful defensiveness and why the player can haggle or press him about the stock.
- HAV_ProdigyLament_Umi.json: Umi is young boy in the Haven. He spends most of his time hunting for valuable items in the Inn. He really looks up to the boss of his crew, Mol. This dialogue covers all his main states in Haven, including isobel and mol's kidnapping, when haven is left unprotected, when it's being attacked etc.
- HAV_TieflingSurvivors_Weaponsmith.json: Dammon has been rescued and returned to the Haven inn, where he’s set up a makeshift Harper’s fire and can serve as a trader/blacksmith in certain states. He was pressed into work in a devil’s smithy when Elturel fell into Avernus and can recognize infernal metal; if the player brings the right hellish material he’ll forge a very powerful weapon. He’s already earned a measure of trust from the party (he even held back mention of this at the druids’ grove), so he’s candid about sensing such metal nearby—probably underground or in shadowed places. Off-screen, Ide and Rolan have recently had a falling-out over Rolan’s drinking and a withheld magical book; Ide is upset and avoiding Rolan, and the player may be able to console Ide, press for the book, or offer to deliver it on Ide’s behalf during these interactions.
- HAV_TieflingSurvivors_KidsAfterGhoulAttack.json: Group dialogs for Tiefling kids when Mol is kidnapped. Ide, Mattis, Umi (and Mirkon, if he survived the harpy attack in the grove) are planning on sneaking out and heading to Moonrise to rescue their 'boss', Mol. The player can offer to go in their place, or encourage them to go (if they go, they die).
- LOW_Dammon.json: Dialog from Dammon in the Act3, when we meet him while in his shop.

context: Mattis is a nervous, proud young tiefling who’s been put in charge of the Last Light Inn’s little “shop” by Mol and is trying — awkwardly — to sound grown‑up and businesslike. Off‑screen, Haven has recently been attacked and several tieflings were killed; the inn is a fragile refuge and some people (like Isobel or Mol) may be missing or kidnapped, which explains why Mattis is protective of the stock and defensive when pressed. Mol entrusted him with a mysterious key that Mattis treats as special and hard to part with, so he’ll hype it up but refuse claims that anyone else (even if they say Mol promised it) automatically gets it. Other survivor relationships (Dammon, Ide, Rolan, and the younger kids like Umi) and recent traumas help explain his prideful defensiveness and eagerness to keep the shop “legitimate.”
